models._comment_4181: fleet-ops#4181 P2: first consumer (the retired agent-cron fable-check). The fallback chain lives in the operator-owned ~/.config/fleet-ops/litellm-proxy.yaml router_settings.fallbacks. Cost is 0 here because the proxy tracks spend in Postgres against the real upstream seats; pi's cost map would double-count.

litellm._comment_4219: fleet-ops#4219 P3a: single provider, all four model groups. P2 pinned the apiKey to the judge-scoped virtual key; P3a's callers need the worker groups too and pi holds one apiKey per provider, so the resolver now emits the master key (fleet-litellm-key master) which accesses every group. Per-tier virtual keys (sk-fleet-worker/senior/private) return in P3b for per-tier spend attribution; group/tag spend tracking in the proxy Postgres is unaffected. The resolver reads the operator-owned env files; no key value is in this file. worker-private left the catalog in fleet-ops#8341 (no served rung — the proxy has no model_name for it; its cap-0 parking stays in seat-caps.json): re-add the id and a rung in the same PR when P3b wires the group.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (direct, last-resort)
models._comment_source: Pricing pinned against DeepSeek published pricing, https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing (retrieved 2026-09-12): PEAK rates for deepseek-flash are 1M input (cache miss) $0.30, 1M output $1.20, 1M input (cache hit) $0.006 — these values are the peak column; off-peak rates are half (input $0.15 / cache-hit $0.003 / output $0.60; peak hours 01:00-04:00 + 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri, all other hours off-peak). Values match the hot-patched numbers from fleet-ops#4712/#5601. The sibling deepseek-v4-pro pricing (1.32/3.96/0.044) also matches the same page's peak column, noted here for the next divergence check.
models._comment_reasoning: fleet-ops#4234/#4625: same treatment as the merged #4234 fix for crof/ollama — DeepSeek V4 Flash reasons by default and bills reasoning to the output budget; reasoning_effort:none is the only value that turns it off. Pi clamps this seat's thinkingLevel to off because reasoning is not declared here. This is a LAST-RESORT metered worker seat (fleet-ops#4625) — never waste reasoning tokens on volume work.

ollama._comment_max_tokens_field: fleet-ops#4234: ollama.com's OpenAI-compat endpoint reads ONLY max_tokens; it accepts max_completion_tokens and silently drops it. Pi's useMaxTokens allowlist (openai-completions detectCompat) does not include ollama.com, so without this compat override every request ran at the endpoint's 65536 ceiling instead of the 16384 configured here, and 80 sessions in 7d ended as one 65536-token reasoning block with zero answer.
